reviews.text: Very happy with the team at Paws Solutions. Was my dogs first grooming and she came out like a fluffy little cloud.

I took my dog George for a regular groom on Tuesday 08/07/2026. The next morning his anal area began looking like these pictures, we went to see the vet, they said he had Anal sacculitis on Thursday morning. They refused to take any responsibility for this matter. I’m very disappointed, my poor dog still looks very upset even today! He never has this issues before.

Took my senior doggy Daisy for grooming and I’m so pleased with the service. The nail trimming was done really carefully, and her face and private areas were groomed beautifully without any irritation. She came out looking tidy, comfortable, and very happy! They were gentle, patient, and clearly care about the animals they work with. I would definitely recommend this place to others and will be back!

My mum has been bringing her Cavalier King Charles here for a few years and the grooming itself has always been excellent. Her dog is happy going in, and he comes home looking beautiful every time. The quality of their work really can’t be faulted.

The issue is the pricing. What started at around €50 has now risen to over €70, which we understand is partly down to rising costs. The upsetting part is the lack of consistency or explanation. One time it will be €63, the next €65, then €68, €70, and most recently €73. It feels almost like the prices are being plucked out of thin air.

My mum often transfers the exact amount into her Revolut account based on the last visit, only to be caught off guard when the card machine is handed over and it’s suddenly a few euro more. On one occasion, she even asked about the increase, but the foreign girl at the desk just handed her the machine. I don’t think she was being rude, more that she didn’t understand the question, but still — there was no explanation given.

Her dog is always brushed daily and in great condition, so the difference isn’t down to extra work. It’s simply that the price keeps creeping up without warning, and it leaves my mum embarrassed and upset every time.

The grooming itself is fantastic, but in this economy, unpredictable and unexplained changes in cost feel very unfair. A clear, consistent price list, or at least being told about increases in advance, would make a huge difference on the door or beforehand. Prices recently just changed on the website but the day she brought her dog over and how much it said on the website was about €10 in the difference .
Been going for over 2 years and no complaints. Our dog is extremely nervous with other but absolutely fine getting groomed.

Would high recommend Paw Solutions Pet Grooming - excellent customer service from start to finish.
Brilliant staff who clearly care not about the money, but about the animals.
We got our 6 month of puppy in here for a puppy pamper session and we are delighted with how it went for her. She came back happy and looking amazing.
Really good experience with Andy. Did an amazing job on my springer spaniel Pip. And she loved it. Will definitely be back. Highly recommend

My dog Yoshi has been coming here for almost 9 years. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Yoshi is very anxious and not good with other dogs. Andy and team really takes this into account and this not only settles Yoshi but me too. He also has had some health complications in recent years with his tail and such and again they take good care of him. He always looks and smells fantastic when he comes out. He looks years younger and even happier in himself. Every dog I see coming out looks like they could be in shows that’s how good a groomer Andy is. We wouldn’t go anywhere else. Really recommend paws solutions, and I appreciated more than ever when Yoshi gets overgrown and I try trim him myself and it looks way worse 😂 thank you and definitely a place to go if you are looking for somewhere your dog can get a professional groom and know they will be cared for and your own concerns listened too. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The pictures are a before and after… this is how good they are 🙈 it looks like in the second picture years since Yoshi has been groomed but it was only 8 weeks, his hair grows so quick but the difference is incredible 🥰

i have used Paws Solutions for over a two years now for our Mini Schnauzer, they are so kind to her and always do a wonderful job. She is very happy to go in, yes they are very busy, but i find them very attentive and most important our dog is happy when she leaves and looks beautiful. thank you guys

Trusted this dog groomers today to wash both our dogs & honestly I was so disappointed, will never return, I didn’t complain I just paid & left, paid €45 & €65 as one dog was bigger an absolute waste of money, both dogs was still wet on collection & honestly just didn’t look or smell clean
Apologies for this one star review guys but I was totally disappointed ⭐️
They do a good groom but very expensive and for some reason take the dogs for much longer than other places. I think sometimes they double book. Good but not amazing
I brought my mini yorkie here and I was very impressed. My dog got a beautiful groom and was very well looked after. I will definitely be booking again.
Been to a few groomers my wife was never happy with but she thought these  groomers did a great job
